revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine. Change the mark up for lin1 because the name is supplied there in the form which would be consistent with the new reading in lin4.
Submit - Inserted the spelling Amenneus in lines 1 and 4 as an editorial correction through PN.

Vote - ReturnToSender - See Vierros' comments. You can argue that the spelling of the name with a single My was much more common. At a quick glance there does not appear to be any clear geographic preference. See http://www.trismegistos.org/nam/detail.php?record=34.

Vote - ReturnToSender - Yes, l. 4 clearly reads Ἀμεννεῖ. I think this should be presented as a PN/PE correction, though, since editor has clearly taken Ammeneus as the basic form (as l.1 supplement shows) and this change is better if made clear in the apparatus.
Submit - Changed the spelling of the name Amenneus in ll. 1 and 4. From the image available online in l. 4 Ἀμεννεῖ is clearly to be read instead of Ἀμμενεῖ.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - lin3: => ἔρρωσο lin10: => [τῶν τῆς αὐτῆς] [.10] [ἄνευ τῆς]; corr => reg lin11: => ἐπιδέδωκεν] [.3] lin12: => ((ἔτους)) lin13: => vestig.3-4lin
